data_source: WebFetch on India job boards (Internshala job listings) + LinkedIn job-search index, verified via WebSearch. JSearch /search endpoint is NOT on the current RapidAPI plan (404); WebSearch (US-only) returned only aggregator index pages, so specific fresh listings were pulled by fetching board pages directly.
ntfy: disabled per user instruction; reported via routine push/email channel (PushNotification)
top_pick: BigStep Technologies — Full Stack Engineer (Node.js+React.js+Medusa.js), Gurugram, match 84, trust 85
notes: ~40+ postings surveyed; most were >1 week old, below the 5.5 LPA floor, off-location (Pune/Chennai/Trivandrum Java roles), internships, or off-role (QA/tester/lecturer/mobile). Freshest genuine dev postings (1-4 days): Birlasoft MERN (Noida), Accenture Custom SWE (Gurugram), BigStep FSE (Gurugram), MindBridge Gen AI (Noida). Strict 24h window yields ~nothing with current tools, so freshest-first within ~1 week used and posted-age shown per job. 5 cover letters generated (match>=75 & trust>=60).
